title: Skill Benchmark and Package Gate
domain: Evidence-backed incident summaries with conflicting sources, unverified claims, and incomplete follow-ups
mission: Prove whether an improved skill adds measurable value over no-skill and starter-skill behavior before deciding to package or reject it.
outcome: Only the exact skill version that passes quality, critical, variance, cost, and archive-integrity gates is distributed; an unproven candidate is rejected.
seededDefects: hypotheses are presented as confirmed causes
archive checks do not bind evaluated files
verificationGates: npm run verify:exercise checks protected inputs, implementation quality, and required submission evidence.
agentWorkflow: package only the passing tree hash or reject the candidate
Capture comparable before and after results using the conditions defined in the exercise README.
workingDeliverables: verified installable archive when the gate passes
